content: N64 decompilation projects (sm64, zeldaret/oot) use NON_MATCHING as an explicit escape hatch: code proven functionally equivalent (same behavior/side effects) is accepted without byte-identical compiled output, verified by asm-differ diffing plus manual/test verification. Modding forks (HackerOoT) fork off the matched decomp and deliberately stop targeting byte match at all once mods begin, verifying instead by build success plus playtesting.
